analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($160.38) vs SMA5/20/50 ($168.16/$190.11/$185.88): below short/mid-term trends, indicating bearish position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($164.26/$153.53): assessing mid-to-long term bearish strength.
· 52-week position (50.7%) + current price level near historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (41.9→31.2) + entering oversold assessment + interpreting downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.8812→-5.0260) + continued worsening diagnosis + bearish trend continuation signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $160.91) + interpreting 30.72% band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($151.06) + basis (based on Pivot S1 level).
· Swing resistance ($161.45) + potential for short-term bounce upon breach.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low support confirmed, below 20-day low) + bearish trend interpretation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.60x) + assessing low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend) + buy entry condition after confirming primary support at $151.06.
